subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Gautam Rao <gautam@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS

Hi Gautam —

Great to connect earlier. Quick recap from our call + a couple of follow-ups so we can put together a targeted hosted-API estimate.

Summary of use case:
- Primary: real-time chat summarization + personalized recommendation snippets served in-app.
- Typical request size: ~800-1,500 tokens (summarize + few-shot context).
- SLA: p95 latency target ~400ms for short completions, occasional async batches ok for large jobs.

What we need from you to produce a hosted pricing estimate and recommend whether to start on Hosted vs Dedicated:
1) Expected monthly token volume (initial and 6-12mo ramp).
2) Peak TPS (requests per second) at peak traffic.
3) Target unit economics / acceptable $ per 1M tokens (if you have a target).
4) Any compliance requirements (PCI/SOC2) that affect deployment.

If you can send numbers for (1)-(3) I’ll get a hosted-cost estimate back to you (line-items: model choice, token pricing, burst/p95 capacity, and recommendation if Dedicated makes sense). I attached a sample pricing model template to fill (redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx).

Next steps: can you reply with the numbers above? I’ll loop Marissa (pricing lead) and Alex (technical) once we have the values.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Gautam Rao <gautam@fintechco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@fintechco.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS

Ben —

Thanks for the recap and template. Putting numbers below (note these are estimates; we expect to refine during the POC):

1) Expected monthly token volume:
- Phase 1 (first 3 months): ~40M tokens / month
- Phase 2 (months 4-12): ramp to ~120-200M tokens / month depending on adoption (we model a base case ~120M)

2) Peak TPS (requests per second):
- Peak traffic (morning batch + surge): ~20-30 req/s
- Average TPS: ~2-5 req/s

3) Target $ / 1M tokens (our target economics):
- We’re aiming for ~$60-$120 per 1M tokens for generation workloads; for embeddings we’d expect a much lower rate but embeddings will be a small fraction initially.

4) Compliance: SOC2 is required; PCI not in scope.

Attached is a short traffic-profile that shows expected hourly distribution (fintechco-traffic-profile.pdf).

Can you provide an initial hosted estimate for 40M and for 120M tokens (including peak capacity considerations)? Also confirm whether those peak TPS numbers would require Dedicated capacity or if Hosted API can handle with auto-scaling/burst.

Happy to hop on a 30m follow-up next week — Priya (cc) will coordinate schedules.

—Gautam
Head of Platform | FintechCo
gautam@fintechco.com

Attachment: fintechco-traffic-profile.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Gautam Rao <gautam@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS

Thanks — this is exactly what we needed. Quick notes and an initial hosted estimate (ballpark) so you have numbers to evaluate against your target economics.

Assumptions we used:
- Average request = 1,000 tokens (mix of 800-1,500).
- Model selection: mid-tier generation model (balanced perf/cost) — we can show a lower-cost quantized variant if you want to favor cost.
- Hosted API includes autoscaling and short-term burst capacity; sustained very high peak TPS sometimes favors Dedicated.

Ballpark hosted pricing (generation):
- 40M tokens / month -> ~$2,400 - $4,800 / month (roughly $60-$120 per 1M tokens)
- 120M tokens / month -> ~$7,200 - $14,400 / month (same unit rate band; discounts available with committed volume)

Notes on peak TPS / capacity:
- For your stated peak of 20-30 req/s (with ~1k tokens/request) Hosted API should handle bursts; sustained 30 req/s 24/7 would push us to recommend Dedicated for predictable latency and cost.
- If you expect daily peaks (rush windows) but low sustained usage, Hosted with burst/autoscaling + KV caching should be fine.

Next steps / asks from our side:
- Confirm whether ~$60-$120 / 1M tokens is within acceptable range (or a tighter target). If your procurement target is closer to $60 / 1M at 120M tokens we can prepare a committed / reserved offer that gets you to that band.
- If you’re open, Marissa will draft a 3-6 month POC pricing and a sample mutual action plan.

I’ll attach a quick estimate sheet and pull Marissa in for a pricing call — Alex can follow up with recommended caching/batching knobs to reduce unit cost.

Thanks — talk soon.
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx (updated with ballpark numbers)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Cc: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>, Priya Singh <priya@fintechco.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS

Hi Gautam —

Thanks for the clarity. I’ll draft a 6-week POC pricing proposal and a mutual action plan to start mid-March. High-level POC offer (draft):
- Duration: 6 weeks
- Scope: Hosted API, mid-tier generation model, standard SOC2 controls
- Tokens: capped at 50M tokens for POC (we can scale to 75M if you need extra headroom)
- Price: exploratory discounted band to target ~$60/1M at scale; POC pricing will be lower to validate performance/cost.

Peak TPS headroom estimate (p95 < 400ms) — rough guidance:
- Hosted (with caching + autoscale): sustained ~10-12 req/s with p95 < 400ms; short bursts to 30 req/s ok for a few minutes.
- Dedicated (single reserved pool): sustained 30+ req/s with consistent p95 < 400ms and lower unit cost at scale.

I’ll send a formal PDF with the mutual action plan and a kickoff calendar invite after Priya shares availability.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Pricing Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
